screen-sharing.q: Will other Zoom participants see the teleprompter?
screen-sharing.a: No. When you share your screen or a window in Zoom, the prompter is hidden by macOS at the system level. Participants see your slides or screen, never the script.

extraFaqs.q: Do I need to authorise anything in the Zoom App Marketplace?
extraFaqs.a: No. {{APP_NAME}} is a standalone macOS app that doesn't connect to Zoom's API. Nothing to install or authorise.

extraFaqs.q: Will Zoom's local or cloud recording capture the window?
extraFaqs.a: No. The window is excluded from capture, so neither local nor cloud recordings contain it.

extraFaqs.q: How do I use a teleprompter with Zoom?
extraFaqs.a:
1. Launch {{APP_NAME}} from the menu bar.
  2. Copy your script and click Start from clipboard.
  3. Drag the transparent window next to your webcam.
  4. Join the Zoom call and share your screen if needed — the prompter stays hidden.
  5. Speak naturally; the script follows your voice.
